title: Psalm 93
program_note: Through works for choir — accompanied or unaccompanied — David Lefkowitz has been exploring the possi­bilities of liturgical music which use new musical language.  Psalm 93, the win­ner of the first ever Guild of Temple Musicians Young Composers Com­petition in 1990, employs more-or-less straightforward choral writing set over a quasi-minimalistic obbligato piano accompa­niment.  It is in­tended for Fri­day night services, or for concert perfor­mance or a High Service.
